mana_diagnostics.interpretation: Native construction heuristic; lower risk is preferred. This is not an EDHPowerLevel percentage or a playtest result.

construction.score_explanation: The search rewards affordable qualifying casts, early interaction, and ways to reach four life lost on one turn.

synergy.summary: Cast noncreature spells to drain the table, cross four life lost before the end step, then use the extra cards to keep casting through the turn cycle.

highlights.title: Fix all three colors
highlights.description: Open with white, blue, and black sources and a cheap mana rock. Aim to cast Y'shtola while keeping cheap interaction available for the next turn. Look for Arcane Signet, Talisman of Dominance, Talisman of Progress.

highlights.title: Get one player to four life lost
highlights.description: Cast noncreature spells with mana value 3 or more. Two triggers in one turn are enough, and adding two more to the same opponent also works. Your own life payments can qualify you separately. Reach four before the end step begins. Paying both life costs on Dismember loses four life at once. Vito can turn one cast trigger into four life lost by the opponent you choose. Look for Dismember, Snuff Out, Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose.

highlights.title: Use other players' turns
highlights.description: Hold up qualifying instants when a player has already lost life that turn. An untap effect makes a second cast easier. Use instant draw spells before the end step when the table is quiet. Queza makes each extra card drain an opponent. Debt to the Deathless can close the game once you have enough mana. Look for Frantic Search, Rewind, Unwind.

synergy.model: A neural ranker learns card fit from Oracle text, card characteristics, and collected lists. Y'shtola's optimizer checks cast mana value, spell timing, and whether life loss can reach the draw threshold.
